stem: Dogs have 39 pairs of chromosomes in their somatic cells. In which part of the cell are these chromosomes replicated during the cell cycle?
visual_elements: A labeled diagram of a cell with 8 parts indicated by numbers 1 through 8
notes: The image shows a cell with 8 labeled parts, but their names are not given in the image. The question asks to select the part where chromosomes are replicated.
